warrants.quote: The Series A Warrants will be exercisable beginning six months from the date of issuance at an exercise price of $1.75 per share, and will expire two years from the date of issuance.
The Series B Warrants will be exercisable beginning six months from the date of issuance at an exercise price of $2.00 per share, and will expire five and one-half years from the date of issuance.
